        long firstDigit = x / tens[len - 1];
        for (int d = 1; d <= 9; d++) {
            long candidate = rep * d;
            if (d == firstDigit || d + 1 == firstDigit)
                best = Math.min(best, len * d + minSteps(Math.abs(candidate - x)));

        return best;
